content:
{'text': 'Machine Gun Kelly 親自澄清一則廣為流傳的假帖文，該帖文聲稱他對「搞砸」前未婚妻 Megan Fox 一事感到後悔。', 'paragraph_context': 'Machine Gun Kelly is clearing the air about a viral fake tweet that alleged he regrets “fumbling” his ex-fiancée Megan Fox.'}

{'text': '這名36歲的饒舌歌手週二回應了這則被錯誤歸咎於他、在社交媒體上瘋傳的假帖文。', 'paragraph_context': 'On Tuesday, the rapper, 36, addressed the faux tweet falsely attributed to him that has been making the rounds on social media.'}

{'text': 'Kelly 否認曾發布的假帖文內容為：「看到這些Megan的新照片，我真的想把手機摔到牆上。」', 'paragraph_context': 'The bogus tweet that Kelly denied posting reads, “Seeing these new pictures of Megan genuinely makes me wanna throw my phone into a f**king wall.”'}

{'text': '「這個星球上最正的女人曾經愛過我，我卻不知怎的搞砸了這一切，」假帖文繼續寫道。「想像一下，搞砸了你的夢中情人，然後還要看著全世界提醒你她有多美。我永遠不會原諒自己幹了這種屁事。」', 'paragraph_context': '“I had the baddest woman to ever walk this planet in love with me and somehow found a way to f**k it all up,” the fraudulent post continued. “Imagine fumbling the girl of your dreams and then having to watch the entire world remind you how beautiful she is. I’ll never forgive myself for that sh*t.”'}

{'text': '這則假帖文於週一以截圖形式流傳，附有 Kelly 的 X 帳號名稱，以及他與 Fox 的合照。', 'paragraph_context': 'The phony tweet had been shared as a screenshot on Monday with Kelly’s X handle, alongside photos of himself and Fox.'}

{'text': 'Kelly 在該假訊息截圖下回覆寫道：「那則帖文假到不行。」', 'paragraph_context': 'Kelly replied under the screenshot of the artificial message, writing, “That tweet is faker than a pair of tits.”'}

{'text': 'HuffPost 已聯絡 Fox 的經紀人團隊，暫未獲回覆。', 'paragraph_context': 'HuffPost has reached out to Fox’s reps for comment.'}

{'text': 'Kelly（本名 Colson Baker）與 Fox 在交往近兩年後，於2022年1月訂婚。這對前夫妻於2025年3月迎來女兒 Saga Blade，卻在2024年12月宣告解除婚約。', 'paragraph_context': 'Kelly, born Colson Baker, and Fox got engaged in January 2022 after nearly two years of dating. The former couple, who welcomed their daughter, Saga Blade, in March 2025, called off their engagement in December 2024.'}

{'text': '在共同育兒的過程中，MGK 對這段舊情依然抱持正面看法。', 'paragraph_context': 'MGK has reflected kindly on his former relationship with Fox amid their co-parenting.'}

{'text': '「這真的是一段關於愛、痛苦和很多魔法的史詩級故事，」他去年在《The Jennifer Hudson Show》上說道。「我曾經和一個最棒的人生伴侶、最棒的孩子的媽在一起過。」', 'paragraph_context': '“It truly was an epic story of love, pain and a lot of magic,” he said on “The Jennifer Hudson Show” last year. “I had it with a person who is the greatest partner, the greatest partner to have had a child with.”'}
